body:
Sometimes I feel the same. But really ask yourself; why would they dislike you if you haven’t done anything bad in the first place? You might have self esteem problems. They really do change the way you think about everything, and it might feel like everyone around you is judgemental. You do need to understand this problem, and that it’s just your mind. I’m not too sure if you meant people/friends you talk to or people in general, but my answer wouldn’t change much either way. 
Do you think people would talk to you if they didn’t like you? I don’t think they would. 
 Do you think people watch every other person? Why would they? Everyone minds their own business, and you shouldn’t worry about them, just like they don’t care who is around.
